newsitem.title: THAILAND: TIPCO unit to build 5 bln baht plant.
newsitem.headline: TIPCO unit to build 5 bln baht plant.

text.p: TIPCO Asphalt Plc said on Wednesday its Thai Bitumen Co Ltd unit had awarded Battle International Inc of the United States a project to build a five billion baht ($200 million) asphalt cement refinery.
TIPCO said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that Bitumen had commissioned Battle International of Houston, Texas, to build the plant in southern Prachuab Khirikhan province.
It said the refinery is due to be completed in October 1998 with an initial annual production capacity of two million tonnes of asphalt cement.
